notes.title: Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Pack - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/b9073e2025a455d4acab0a3d059f106ce1ed1f85.png[/img]

Hey all,

We're happy to say that [b]Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Pack is out now! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/5192e1b9bde7b7deb72da5997d2eb1c5f58e0222.gif[/img]

Inertial Drift fans on PC, PlayStation 4 Xbox One & Nintendo Switch can enjoy fresh content with the 'Twilight Rivals Pack', coming stacked with: 

[list]
[*] Brand new 'Twilight Rivals' single player story mode.
[*] All-new Eurobeat Soundtrack, mixed by renowned producer '[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FciLaexQ9-8]Turbo[/url]'
[*] Four tracks, including reversible routes.
[*] Four new cars, all exclusively unique from each other!
[*] And more!
[/list]

'Inertial Drift Twilight Rivals Pack' for PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One releases alongside 'Inertial Drift Twilight Rivals Edition' for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. 

Nintendo Switch DLC content will be releasing later this year. 


Buy the Twilight Rivals Pack Now:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075290/Inertial_Drift__Twilight_Rivals_DLC/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075290/Inertial_Drift__Twilight_Rivals_DLC/[/url]

notes.title: Brand new animated opening for Twilight Rivals Pack
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are very happy to premiere our brand new animated opening for the Twilight Rivals DLC Pack, coming later this year. In the animation you'll be introduced to the four all-new characters that you'll be tasked taking on, all set to the electrifying, highly requested Eurobeat theme song, mixed by prominent producer, Turbo! 

[b][list][*] Get a taste of the highly requested, all-new soundtrack from Eurobeat master Turbo!
[*] Check out our brand new opening animation to the Twilight Rivals story mode!
[*]An exclusive look at the new cars and tracks coming to 'Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Edition' with all new screenshots![/list][/b]

[previewyoutube=Y78V4A-O3a0;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]What Is Coming To 'Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Pack DLC'?[/b]

Set in a '90s retro future, ‘Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals DLC’ is an arcade racer with a devastatingly unique handling model and unbelievably satisfying twin-stick drift mechanics!

[list]
[*] Challenge The 'Twilight Rivals' In An All-New Story Mode - When the 'Twilight Rivals' arrive on the scene they quickly establish themselves as the hardest challenge you've faced yet. 

[*] 4 Fiercely Individual Cars - Each vehicle is a totally different beast with unique characteristics to master. Get behind the wheel and try to tame sport hatchbacks, coupes, supercars and more.

[*] 4 Demanding Tracks - Tear through neon city streets, race around rural temple complexes and hurtle down winding mountain passes. Mastered each track? Reverse the route and start at the finish line for an all-new experience.

[*] Local & Online Multiplayer - Think you've mastered the perfect drift? What better way to prove it than going head-to-head with friends both online and locally or testing your best laps with car-specific leaderboards!
[/list]

notes.title: Twilight Rivals Pack DLC Announced - Coming This Year!
notes.content:
We bring you exciting news in the form of brand new content!

[h3][b]DLC IS ON THE WAY![/b][/h3]

The team have been working on the new Twilight Rivals Edition for Inertial Drift and it is our pleasure to update you and finally bring you into the loop on what's coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/b14a211998708c8cc0ecc08ec1da05ec774a0eab.png[/img]

[u][b][h1]What's New?[/h1][/b][/u]
[h2]Brand new 'Twilight Rivals' single player story mode [/h2]

We will be introducing new rivals and a cool new story mode to enjoy. Can you take on the new characters on the block?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/6c56ba56ccae63965bf842c1bba164c431dc9c5e.png[/img]

[h2]Four thrilling new tracks, including reversible routes[/h2]

Challenging new tracks to really put your skills to the test - You will find unique environments, demanding  circuits and even more imaginative maps to sink your teeth into!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/780412e6e12bc5446c7670bd1466e89f20148ee3.png[/img]

[h2]Four new cars to master, all exclusively unique from each other![/h2] 

Amazing new cars with unique drifting mechanics to learn. Can you put your pedal to the metal with these impressive new beasts?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/a788f41fcd1b054e1b8fb8dc646c0db24bacc0ec.png[/img]

And much more! So be sure to keep those eyes peeled for updates here and on our social channels...we are almost at the starting line for the next stage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/7f6e63b1f99c85c3df182f2d63b2dcc84cb50ad8.gif[/img]

Thank you from The Level 91 and PQube team

notes.title: INERTIAL DRIFT IS EVOLVING!
notes.content:
[h1]WELCOME TO UPDATE #1![/h1]
We're really happy to announce today that big changes are coming to Inertial Drift - but before we get to that, we have to say a huge thank you to everyone who has shown support, bought, downloaded, wishlisted or reviewed Inertial drift. 

Over the past year, we've been thinking about how we can improve and grow the overall experience and today is the first day of that journey into expanding the Inertial Drift universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/8fe11ac0215f0572dcf6dcedad9f15a0cfe16c86.png[/img]

As some of you will have noticed there are some changes to the current roster, specifically;

- The original Roton 7D is now Class B with updated handling.
- We've also added a New upgraded Roton 7D Super for Class A.

In the coming months we will release a further three upgraded cars to the roster as well. We're currently aiming to have one added to Inertial Drift every month.

Perhaps most importantly however, we have overhauled the leaderboards. From today, there are new individual Time Attack Leaderboards for each car - it's a big move and will hopefully be the groundwork Inertial Drift needed to make this part of the game more compelling and competitive - allowing you to prove your worth with each individual car against other players globally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/4b923c24f383d0dd4e417b4bbceb23b69a0255c7.jpg[/img]

Now that this groundwork has been completed - what are the next steps?

We're looking forward to rolling these out into next year, so please bear with us for more specific details on the roadmap - but they will include; 

- New tracks! 
- Brand new cars 
- Expanded single player content.
- Visual Improvements
- And some nice surprises!

If you're only just arriving at Inertial Drift, you'll find the game current discounted in store, so there's never been a better time to join us and find out what makes Inertial Drift so unique. We hope you enjoy your time with us and join us for the long road ahead.

Take care and all the best,
The Level 91 and PQube team.

notes.title: Steam Patch Notes - 23.09.20
notes.content:
Hello Drifters, 

We've been overwhelmed by your enthusiasm and support for Inertial Drift over the past couple of weeks. Thanks to everyone who has provided thoughts, feedback and ideas as to how we can improve the game. We will assess all of these and will look to make improvements to the game in subsequent updates. 

For the time being, a smaller update is now live on Steam: 
[list]
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the events in several [b]Challenges[/b] and [b]Grand Prix Mode[/b]. Including those for Dragon, Chrono, 7D, Jet Z, Bullet, Jester, Gecko RX and Gladio. 
[*] Added the ability to Finish Event early from the pause menu in Endurance events after a medal has been achieved.
[/list]

Remember that you can join our new [url=https://discord.gg/AxXHwgJ][b]Discord Server[/b][/url] to join the discussion about the game! 

Happy Drifting! 

- PQube & Level 91 Entertainment

notes.title: Development Update - New features to help you learn from your opponents
notes.content:
[h3]In Inertial Drift, you'll need to learn from your competitors as well as compete with them! Studying the lines that others are using could give you an edge in those intense 1v1 races, and the team have recently introduced two new upgrades to help you do just that![/h3]


[i][b]Break Trails That Hang in the Air [/b]
[previewyoutube=csaVrki3YIw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're already familiar with Inertial Drift, you'll know that the break trails from your car and your opponent's car hang in the air for a short while. Notice your opponent acing a tricky corner? Study their break trails to see exactly where they applied and released the breaks!

A new proximity based fade sees the trails fade-out as you cover the same ground, allowing you to replicate your opponent's throttle & break timings in real-time. 


[b]Glowing Skid Trails [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36398504/ad6963148dcb435ab4c7c4f25ac5e7895cddf009.png[/img]

Another recent addition comes in the form of glowing skid trails. Racing ghosts - whether your own or somebody else's - is another invaluable opportunity to hone your craft. These new glowing skid-trails for ghosts make it even easier to study their lines. 


Remember, each car in Inertial Drift is different! Simply copying what your opponent does is no guaruntee of success...


Thanks and stay tuned for more!
- PQube & Level 91 Entertainment[/i]



Find out more about Inertial Drift at [url=http://pqube.co.uk/inertial-drift]http://pqube.co.uk/inertial-drift[/url]
